import MilneLib.Sheaf.LinearizedInvariantSheafOverlap
import MilneLib.Sheaf.LinearizedInvariantSheafTransitionCoherence
import MilneLib.Quotient.InvariantQuotientStableGlueData

/-!
# Invariant module sheaves on the quotient atlas

The chart modules and their overlap isomorphisms use the existing quotient
scheme gluing datum. They are constructed from the sections of the original
linearized quasicoherent sheaf. The diagonal transition is the canonical
pullback identification. Triple-overlap coherence remains necessary before
these modules can be glued effectively.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
open MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction
open MilneLib.StableGroupAction.ModuleLinearization

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen

variable {K L J : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [Finite J]
  {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.IsSeparated]
  {act : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Aut X}
  (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))
  (hact : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
    (act g).hom ≫ p = p ≫ (specAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g).hom)
  {F : X.Modules} (D : ModuleLinearization act F)
  (C : J → StableAffineOpen act)

local notation "pK" => p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
local notation "hK" => galois_action_comp_base act p hact
local notation "Q" => stableQuotientGlueData act pK hK C

/-- The invariant module of a linearized sheaf's sections, realized as a
native module sheaf on the corresponding chart of the quotient atlas. -/
noncomputable def linearizedInvariantSheafChart (i : J) : ((Q).U i).Modules := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK (C i).U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p (C i).U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p (C i).U
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act (C i).stable
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact (C i).stable
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK (C i).stable
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction (C i).stable
  letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass (C i).stable
  exact tilde (ModuleCat.of
    (CommRingCat.of (FixedPoints.subalgebra K Γ(X, (C i).U) (L ≃ₐ[K] L)))
    (invariantModule K L Γ(X, (C i).U) Γ(F, (C i).U)))

/-- The actual quotient atlas transitions identify the pullbacks of its
invariant chart sheaves. This is the pairwise input to module-sheaf gluing. -/
noncomputable def linearizedInvariantSheafAtlasTransitionIso
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] (i j : J) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((Q).f i j)).obj (linearizedInvariantSheafChart p hact D C i) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((Q).t i j ≫ (Q).f j i)).obj
        (linearizedInvariantSheafChart p hact D C j) := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK (C i).U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK (C j).U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p (C i).U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p (C j).U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p (C i).U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p (C j).U
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act (C i).stable
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act (C j).stable
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact (C i).stable
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact (C j).stable
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK (C i).stable
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK (C j).stable
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction (C i).stable
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction (C j).stable
  letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass (C i).stable
  letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass (C j).stable
  let qi := quotientOverlapι act pK hK (C i) (C j)
  let qj := quotientOverlapι act pK hK (C j) (C i)
  let s := (quotientOverlapSwapIso act pK hK (C i) (C j)).hom
  let Fi := linearizedInvariantSheafChart p hact D C i
  let Fj := linearizedInvariantSheafChart p hact D C j
  exact ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback qi).app Fi).symm ≪≫
    linearizedInvariantSheafTransitionIso p hact D (C i) (C j) ≪≫
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp s qj).app Fj).symm ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (s ≫ qj)).app Fj

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The invariant chart transitions satisfy the diagonal identity required by
module-sheaf gluing on the actual quotient atlas. -/
theorem linearizedInvariantSheafAtlasTransitionIso_self
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] (i : J) :
    linearizedInvariantSheafAtlasTransitionIso p hact D C i i =
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun f => (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj
        (linearizedInvariantSheafChart p hact D C i))
        (show (Q).f i i = (Q).t i i ≫ (Q).f i i by
          rw [(Q).t_id i, Category.id_comp])) := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK (C i).U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p (C i).U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p (C i).U
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act (C i).stable
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact (C i).stable
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK (C i).stable
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction (C i).stable
  letI := D.sectionsSMulDistribClass (C i).stable
  let q := quotientOverlapι act pK hK (C i) (C i)
  let s := (quotientOverlapSwapIso act pK hK (C i) (C i)).hom
  let N := linearizedInvariantSheafChart p hact D C i
  have hq : q = s ≫ q := by simp [s, quotientOverlapSwapIso_self]
  dsimp only [linearizedInvariantSheafAtlasTransitionIso]
  rw [linearizedInvariantSheafTransitionIso_self]
  change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).app N).symm ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hq).app N ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp s q).app N) ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp s q).app N).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (s ≫ q)).app N =
    eqToIso (congrArg (fun f => (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj N) hq)
  rw [Iso.trans_assoc, Iso.self_symm_id_assoc]
  exact Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback_congr_eqToIso hq N

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen
